title: ptelea trifoliata subsp. polyadenia
intro: Ptelea trifoliata subsp. polyadenia, commonly known as Western or American prickly ash, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve pain, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Western or American prickly ash include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, ease muscle spasms, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
